vibe: Elegant, Modern, Reassuring, Highly Legible, Urgent

global_rules.sunlight_legibility: High contrast is mandatory. Avoid subtle greys on dark backgrounds for critical text. Use stark white (#FFFFFF) against deep navy.
global_rules.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements to accommodate moving environments (boats/waves).
global_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="report-fab"`).

typography.primary_font: System (SF Pro Display / Roboto) or Manrope if custom fonts are configured

h1_distress.description: Used ONLY for SOS countdown and critical GPS coordinates

body_large.description: Used for main buttons and key readable text

map_view.description: Full screen OpenSeaMap tiles. Map should ideally have a dark/night mode style applied to tiles if possible. User location is a prominent glowing turquoise dot.

fab_report.position: Bottom right, above bottom nav/safe area

bottom_sheet_report.grid: 2 columns for report types to maximize tap area

items.style: Vertical stack: 48x48px circle icon background + Label below

report_detail.actions: Large 'Confirmer / Mettre à jour' primary button
report_detail.media: Horizontal scroll view for photo gallery
report_detail.chat: Mini-chat section at bottom with clear input field and send button

main_action.label: APPELER LE 1616
main_action.countdown: 5s display above/inside button before auto-call (if implemented)

gps_display.layout: Top of screen, highly visible card

distress_screen.secondary_numbers: List below the main button (VHF Canal 16, CROSS, etc.)

weather_alerts.card_style: Background #1C2541, Border left 4px solid depending on severity (Red/Orange/Yellow)
weather_alerts.content: Title, Date/Time, Description. High contrast text.

profile.history: List of past reports with small icon and date

sections.title: Checklist matériel
sections.style: Checkbox list with strikethrough on check

sections.title: Bouées cardinales
sections.style: Visual grid showing North, South, East, West buoys with their light patterns

auth.background: Deep navy with subtle ocean background image

buttons.google: Solid #FFFFFF with dark text (#0B132B) and Google icon

icons.usage: Use solid shapes where possible for better visibility in sunlight.

onboarding_background.description: Aerial view of a boat on dark blue sea, perfect for auth/onboarding background with a heavy dark overlay.

distress_background.description: Calm ocean background for general app empty states or calm mode.

avatar_placeholder.description: Cartoon sailor avatar for default profile picture.

buoy_reference.description: Reference image for safety screen buoy section.

instructions_to_main_agent.stack: React Native (Expo), use StyleSheet or NativeWind for styling (.js files).
instructions_to_main_agent.navigation: Use React Navigation (Bottom Tabs + Stack for Distress/Report details).
instructions_to_main_agent.map: Use react-native-maps. If OpenSeaMap tiles are required, use UrlTile component over the standard map.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme: Force dark mode in app configuration or set default background colors to Deep Navy (#0B132B).
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility: Ensure all text has extremely high contrast for readability at sea.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add data-testid to ALL touchable elements and inputs.
